preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Treasury Stress Test Results'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT r.currency_code AS currency, r.id AS run_id, r.scenario_code AS scenario, r.scenario_version, r.survival_days, r.survival_beyond_horizon AS beyond_horizon, r.baseline_survival_days, b.bucket_seq, b.bucket_code AS bucket, b.baseline_net, b.baseline_cumulative, b.stressed_net, b.stressed_cumulative, b.liquid_capacity, b.funding_capacity, b.stressed_position FROM m_treasury_run r JOIN m_treasury_run_stress_bucket b ON b.run_id = r.id WHERE r.run_type = 'STRESS' AND r.office_id IS NULL AND r.as_of_date = '${asOn}' ORDER BY r.currency_code, r.scenario_code, b.bucket_seq

column.name: description
column.value: The institution stress runs of a date: each scenario's survival horizon and, per bucket, the baseline and stressed gaps, the capacity and the position.

column.name: report_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Treasury Stress Test Results')

column.name: parameter_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_parameter WHERE parameter_name = 'asOnDate')

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Treasury Contingency Funding Plan'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT f.code, f.name, f.source_type, f.currency_code AS currency, c.name AS counterparty, f.committed_amount, f.drawn_amount, COALESCE(f.available_amount, GREATEST(f.committed_amount - f.drawn_amount, 0)) AS available_amount, f.days_to_access, f.expiry_date, COALESCE(u.username, f.owner_name) AS owner, f.include_in_capacity, f.status FROM m_treasury_funding_line f LEFT JOIN m_treasury_counterparty c ON c.id = f.counterparty_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser u ON u.id = f.owner_user_id WHERE f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (f.expiry_date IS NULL OR f.expiry_date >= '${asOn}') ORDER BY f.currency_code, f.days_to_access, f.source_type, f.code

column.name: description
column.value: The funding lines of the contingency funding plan available on a date: source, amounts, days to access, expiry and owner.

column.name: report_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Treasury Contingency Funding Plan')

column.name: parameter_id
column.valueComputed: (SELECT id FROM stretchy_parameter WHERE parameter_name = 'asOnDate')

column.name: description
column.value: Builds the maturity ladder of every organisation currency for the business date with the default rule set and the active assumption set, computes the rule set's ratios and runs every active stress scenario over it, replacing that date's earlier runs unless a return of the date has been submitted; each run evaluates its limits and the stress runs the contingency funding plan's survival triggers. Runs after Treasury Position Snapshot.
